recording.title: Browsing records
recording.description: Counts page visits and only tracks time on the active tab of the focused window.

privacy.title: Local and private
privacy.description:
Stores only site domains, times, and visit counts — never page content, titles, or full URLs.
Ignores incognito windows and internal browser pages, and never sends data to a server.

method.title: How it's measured
method.description:
Each page load or reload counts as one visit; switching tabs or in-app navigation in single-page apps doesn't add visits.
{{idle}} seconds without system input counts as idle; progress is saved every {{checkpoint}} seconds.
Keeps up to {{days}} days of data, with at most {{limit}} visits and {{limit}} active sessions.

clear.title: Clear all records
clear.description: Deletes the records PageTime has saved on this device. This can't be undone.

confirm.title: Clear all browsing records?
confirm.description: This deletes only PageTime's local data and can't be undone.

howItWorks.title: How PageTime counts time
howItWorks.intro: PageTime only counts time you actually spend looking at a page. The rules are below.

counted.title: What counts
counted.focus: The selected tab in a focused foreground window
counted.web: Only http and https pages, totaled by domain
counted.navigation: When the same tab navigates to another site, time on the new site starts at that navigation

notCounted.title: What doesn't count
notCounted.idle_one: {{count}} second in a row without keyboard or mouse input (including watching video or listening to audio)
notCounted.idle_other: {{count}} seconds in a row without keyboard or mouse input (including watching video or listening to audio)
notCounted.locked: While the screen is locked, the computer is asleep, or the browser is closed
notCounted.unfocused: A minimized window, another app in front, or focused DevTools
notCounted.internal: Browser internal pages, extension pages, and local files
notCounted.gap_one: When checks are more than {{count}} second apart, at most {{count}} second of that gap is counted (for example, while the system is suspended)
notCounted.gap_other: When checks are more than {{count}} seconds apart, at most {{count}} seconds of that gap are counted (for example, while the system is suspended)

visits.title: How visits are counted
visits.description: A page load or reload counts as 1 visit. Switching tabs and in-app navigation in single-page apps do not.

privacy.title: Privacy and storage
privacy.fields: Only the domain, times, and visit counts are saved — never the title, page text, or full URL.
privacy.local: Data stays in this browser on this device and is never uploaded to a server.
privacy.retention_one: Keeps the last {{count}} day, with at most {{limit}} time spans and {{limit}} visit records.
privacy.retention_other: Keeps the last {{count}} days, with at most {{limit}} time spans and {{limit}} visit records.
privacy.save_one: Saves every {{count}} second. If the browser closes unexpectedly, at most that recent interval can be lost.
privacy.save_other: Saves every {{count}} seconds. If the browser closes unexpectedly, at most that recent interval can be lost.
